verdict.rationale: Lambda publishes its own API reference (docs-api.lambda.ai lists endpoints such as list/create workspace) and serves a full OpenAPI 3.1 spec keylessly. However, nothing shows the reference is interactive or offers runnable "try it" examples, and the API itself is key-gated. missing for 10: evidence of interactive try-it/runnable request execution in the reference, code samples per endpoint, independent or hands-on corroboration of the reference experience.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: The Lambda Cloud API provides a set of REST API endpoints you can use to create and manage your Lambda Cloud resources.
https://cloud.lambda.ai/api/v1/openapi.json serves the full Lambda Cloud API OpenAPI 3.1 spec
